A mixture of commercially pure metals under a high-purity argon atmosphere was melted and solidified on a water-cooled Cu hearth to produce an alloy ingot. The Ti-getter has been placed inside the vacuum chamber so as to avoid any oxidation during melting. The purities of raw materials were higher than 99.9 mass%. The as-prepared ingots with ~35 g in weight were flipped and re-melted for at least five times to attaining homogenization.

evidence.section: 4.2. Strengthening mechanism of NbMoTaWHf at room temperature
evidence.quote: The strengthening mechanism of NbMoTaWHf at room temperature can mainly be ascribed to the combination of solid-solution strengthening and second-phase strengthening.

evidence.quote: Second, the secondary BCC2 phase interacted with the BCC1 phase, enhancing the alloys by means of second-phase strengthening. The massive dispersion of second-phase particles retards the dislocation motion, potentially increasing the strength of the alloy.
The high strength of NbMoTaWHf RHEA at elevated temperatures was mainly ascribed to the high softening temperature, the second-phase strengthening, and solid-solution strengthening.
